channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ) (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): RH's May 13, 2022 release gives the opening date (the record had May 12) and describes a rooftop park and two wine bars, not a rooftop bar. The record no longer says the rehabilitation was complete in 2020 (the Port's January 2019 list of 2020 milestones was a forecast), and the site-wide December 2020 completion entry was removed. Building area is stated as RH's 80,000 sq ft for the whole building, not galleries; the January 2019 Port update is dated by its Jan 4 memo; the retired Assessor lot 4046001 is described as retired on 2018-10-02 rather than as the building's current lot; and an earlier change entry no longer says RH bought the building. RH San Francisco has not been re-confirmed as operating since 2022.
item.description: RH's May 13, 2022 release gives the opening date (the record had May 12) and describes a rooftop park and two wine bars, not a rooftop bar. item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): The eight-building Historic Core's $127M total rehabilitation cost (Port Item 12A, Jan 4, 2019, Table 2: $127.0 million; the memo's text says an estimated $125 million) had been copied identically onto the cost entries of Buildings 101, 102, 104, 113/116 and 14. It now appears once, in the shared site-wide cost list as a development cost for the Pier 70 Historic Core, with all five records pointing to it. Each building keeps its own hard-cost figure as a construction cost for that building.

item.title: Added · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): RH San Francisco (The Gallery at the Historic Bethlehem Steel Building) opened May 13, 2022 in Building 101, a showroom with the Palm Court restaurant, two wine bars and a rooftop park (RH press release, May 13, 2022). RH has subleased the building since February 2017 under a 41-year sublease (Port Item 12A, Jan 2019).
